verdict.rationale: QuickBooks' own Intuit Intelligence agent is documented as able to 'help resolve anomalies', which touches the core of this story. Nothing shows it continuously monitoring the ledger, detecting spend anomalies or duplicate transactions, or tying any of this to the close. The discrepancy reports are manual reports, Payroll AI covers payroll rather than the ledger, and the MCP server is a developer building block, so none of these earn credit. Missing for 10: proactive or scheduled ledger monitoring, documented duplicate-transaction detection, spend-anomaly flagging specifics, a pre-close workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close

citations.quote: Speed up business by telling Intuit Intelligence chat to create invoices, help resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports, estimate tax savings, and more.
